feature_results.external_baseline_summary: Events are uniquely identified and deduplicated; mutations are idempotent; positive attestations bind verifiable subject/evidence identity and producer context.

feature_results.conclusion_change_summary: External baselines confirm all packet gaps and elevate evidence-free certification to a semantic contradiction.
proposed_spec_deltas: Require expected_goal_revision, idempotency_key, event source/id/type/schema, atomic event-plus-outbox commit, typed conflict/retry policy, hash-linked chain head, retention/checkpoint rules, evidence subject digests, positive verifier outcome, signer identity, timestamp, and revocation status.
scenario_implications: A retry returns the original event/result; projection rebuild reproduces the certified revision; certification fails closed when evidence is absent, stale, mismatched, or revoked.
adversarial_implications: Attackers cannot replay writes, splice receipt history, substitute evidence, or self-issue a positive certification without verifiable provenance.
